assertion.rationale: F9 (Task 13): 3.3.1's and 3.3.2's collection and traceability gaps are both closed (Key Vault, storage, SQL database, CAE diagnosticSettings, the subscription Activity Log, and Entra ID SignInLogs/AuditLogs all land in the same Log Analytics workspace platform/main.bicep and layer-06-platform.yml wire), so cross-resource correlation in KQL against a single workspace now spans both the Azure resource plane and the Entra identity plane -- correlating a suspicious Key Vault AuditEvent or SQL query against WHO authenticated to get there, or against a Conditional Access decision, is possible. lawDataRetentionDays is raised 30 -> 90 (platform/main.bicep), meeting the AU-11 convention and DFARS 252.204-7012(e)'s 90-day preservation obligation for all of it. A first pass deferred the Entra routing as unverifiable without a live tenant; review corrected that (the Microsoft.aadiam resource shape and required Security Administrator role are publicly documented) and it is now implemented with the same verb the Activity Log step uses. One recorded, separate loose end (not a reason this control reopens, same treatment F20/F21 got under F13): whether mls-github-deployer actually holds the Security Administrator role the Entra step needs at runtime is unverified without a live tenant -- recorded in that step's own comment. This control's gap was explicitly bounded by whichever of 3.3.1/3.3.2 was worse; a prior pass downgraded its gapSeverity to medium alongside theirs for partial progress, reverted on review per 3.1.5.json's precedent that severity does not discount for partial progress. With 3.3.1 and 3.3.2 both now closed, this control closes too, for the same reason. Checked: no other finding in compliance/findings/2026-08-26-prepublication-review.md cites 3.3.5.

recommendation: None outstanding for this control. Correlation, analysis and reporting capacity, and the retention window to support it, now span the full estate this task could reach. A regression in 3.3.1 or 3.3.2's collection (see those files) would reopen this control along with them. The unverified Security Administrator prerequisite for the Entra step does not itself reopen it.
